turns.prompt:
You are given an attached CSV file b3_fatigue_target.csv: 284 real samples,
the process/composition columns (NT, THT, THt, THQCr, CT, Ct, DT, Dt, QmT,
TT, Tt, TCr, C, Si, Mn, P, S, Ni, Cr, Cu, Mo, RedRatio, dA, dB, dC) and
column `target` (the measured rotating-bending fatigue strength (MPa)).

Propose a recipe (a value for each variable below), within each observed
range, whose rotating-bending fatigue strength (MPa) is AS CLOSE AS POSSIBLE
to 800. Design variables:
  - NT (value in [825, 930])
  - THT (value in [30, 865])
  - THt (value in [0, 30])
  - THQCr (value in [0, 24])
  - CT (value in [30, 930])
  - Ct (value in [0, 540])
  - DT (value in [30, 903.333])
  - Dt (value in [0, 70.2])
  - QmT (value in [30, 140])
  - TT (value in [30, 680])
  - Tt (value in [0, 120])
  - TCr (value in [0, 24])
  - C (value in [0.17, 0.63])
  - Si (value in [0.16, 2.05])
  - Mn (value in [0.37, 1.6])
  - P (value in [0.002, 0.031])
  - S (value in [0.003, 0.03])
  - Ni (value in [0.01, 2.78])
  - Cr (value in [0.01, 1.17])
  - Cu (value in [0.01, 0.26])
  - Mo (value in [0, 0.24])
  - RedRatio (value in [240, 5530])
  - dA (value in [0, 0.13])
  - dB (value in [0, 0.05])
  - dC (value in [0, 0.058])

Reason from the training data, then end with your explicit proposal, e.g.
"Final: NT=877.5, THT=447.5, THt=15, THQCr=12, CT=480, Ct=270, DT=466.666,
Dt=35.1, QmT=85, TT=355, Tt=60, TCr=12, C=0.4, Si=1.105, Mn=0.985, P=0.0165,
S=0.0165, Ni=1.395, Cr=0.59, Cu=0.135, Mo=0.12, RedRatio=2885, dA=0.065,
dB=0.025, dC=0.029".
turns.answer_text:
The data show two distinct high-strength routes. The most conservative route toward 800 MPa is to start from the strongest conventional heat-treatment sample below the target (718 MPa) and reduce only its tempering temperature `TT`. Across repeated compositions in the 580–680 °C region, lowering `TT` raises fatigue strength by approximately 1.1–1.3 MPa/°C. Using about 1.18 MPa/°C, an 82 MPa increase requires a reduction of roughly 69.5 °C:

\[
TT \approx 490-82/1.18 \approx 420.5^\circ\text{C}.
\]

This retains an observed, internally consistent composition and process recipe while changing only one variable. The estimated fatigue strength is approximately 800 MPa, though this involves modest extrapolation below the locally observed tempering temperatures.
